import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

repo = pathlib.Path.cwd()
review_dir = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='batch-report-review-', dir='/tmp'))
paths = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z'], cwd=repo).decode().split('\\0')
probe = '''
import app
import json
rows = []
for configured_default in (False, True):
    app.DETAILED_REPORT = configured_default
    for values in ([], [2, 4], [0], [-2, 1], [1, 2, 2]):
        for mode in ('omitted', None, False, True):
            try:
                result = app.report(values) if mode == 'omitted' else app.report(values, detailed=mode)
                outcome = {'result': result}
            except Exception as exc:
                outcome = {'error': type(exc).__name__, 'message': str(exc)}
            rows.append({'default': configured_default, 'values': values, 'mode': mode, **outcome})
print(json.dumps(rows))
'''
results = {}
for name, revision in (('base', 'HEAD'), ('staged', '')):
    snapshot = review_dir / name
    snapshot.mkdir()
    for path in filter(None, paths):
        target = snapshot / path
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'{revision}:{path}'], cwd=repo))
    test = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-v'], cwd=snapshot, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(f'{name} tests (exit {test.returncode}):\\n{test.stdout}{test.stderr}')
    if test.returncode:
        raise SystemExit(test.returncode)
    results[name] = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([sys.executable, '-B', '-c', probe], cwd=snapshot))

for old, new in zip(results['base'], results['staged']):
    expected = dict(old)
    if 'result' in expected:
        expected['result'] = expected['result'].replace('Items:', 'Records:', 1)
    assert new == expected, (old, new)
    if 'result' in new:
        effective_mode = new['default'] if new['mode'] in ('omitted', None) else new['mode']
        expected_output = f\"Records: {len(new['values'])}\"
        if effective_mode:
            expected_output += f\"; Mean: {sum(new['values']) / len(new['values']):g}\"
        assert new['result'] == expected_output, new

errors = [row for row in results['staged'] if 'error' in row]
print(f\"Verified {len(results['staged'])} base/candidate scenario pairs; every successful result differs only by the requested label.\")
print('Scenarios: both configured defaults; omitted, None, False, True modes; empty, populated, zero, negative, fractional-mean batches.')
print(f'Inherited error cases ({len(errors)}): {json.dumps(errors)}')
print(f'Review snapshots: {review_dir}')
PY"
